Primary request: Fix tiny-subject / perceptual-world framing in this shot. Create exactly ONE animal, Milo using the attached canonical identity roots on the attached registered location. The left mossy boulder and nearby dirt/fern boundaries must be recognizably magnified by the same camera crop.
